preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access the mint function

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) function to create unlimited new tokens. The minted tokens are added to the total supply and credited to the specified address. The attacker can mint tokens to their own address and then sell them on a DEX, diluting existing holders' value and extracting profit. Key steps: 1) Verify owner status via owner() function, 2) Call mint(attacker_address, large_amount), 3) Transfer or swap minted tokens for other assets.
